senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) grief, pain, toil.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:7">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 5:10">Prov. V, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01094"><he>עֶצֶב</he></cite>) <he>לומר שיאכלו בע׳ וכ׳</he> intimating that they shall eat with toil whatever they may eat (with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:17">Gen. III, 17</cite>).

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 14:5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIV</cite> <he>בעִצְּבוֹן גדולו</he>, v. <cite ref="O00461"><he>סָחַף</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="P01098"><he>עִצְּבוֹנוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI, 4</cite> <he>הרבית ע׳ לבני אדם</he> ed. Bub. (missing in oth. ed.) thou didst decree many pains unto man (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>, sq.); <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">ib.</cite> <he>הרבית ע׳ לאבות העולם</he> thou didst decree many troubles unto the patriarchs; <he>הרבית ע׳ לדורו של שמד</he> thou didst decree … upon the generation of (the Hadrianic) persecution; Yalk. ib. 667.—[V. next w.].
